observed_limitations: The unauthenticated API exposes at most ten records per request; broad queries require pagination.
Exact-DOI lookup requires knowing the article identifier in advance and is not a natural-language relevance evaluation.
These captured metadata results are not a manually judged topical relevance benchmark.

The documented quoted DOI search returned zero records for 10.1093/ptep/ptaf001, although that DOI is present in the corpus as SCOAP3 record 95323 and corroborated by the original article XML. This is a captured query failure, not an inferred relevance score.
comparison_scope: External repository search covers the entire repository; our local corpus is its journal/length/license-filtered subset. Counts are not directly comparable as relevance metrics.
